data.one_liner: Rate limiting middleware for the Shelf web framework in Dart.
data.what_it_does: shelf_limiter is a customizable rate limiting middleware for the Shelf library. It allows developers to control request rates globally or configure different limits per endpoint using wildcard path matching.
use_when: You are building a Dart backend using the Shelf library and need to protect APIs from abuse.
You require customizable rate limits with support for endpoint-specific rules and custom headers.
avoid_when: You are not using the Shelf library for your Dart backend.
You need distributed rate limiting across multiple server instances (the package manages state in-memory).
strengths: Supports endpoint-specific limits and wildcard path matching like `/api/v1/*`.
Allows customizing rate-limit-exceeded responses and adding custom response headers.
Easy integration into existing Shelf middleware pipelines.
weaknesses: Lacks documented distributed storage backend support for multi-instance deployments out of the box.
